summary: This Phase 3 study looks at how well a drug called maridebart cafraglutide works for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus and who have obesity or are overweight. The trial has an enrollment of 1105 participants and is sponsored by Amgen. The current status is Active, not recruiting. Participants will receive either the study drug in different doses or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug.
